Prostate-specific antigen monitoring
Measurement of PSA is the cornerstone of follow-up after local treatment. While PSA thresholds depend on the
local treatment used, PSA recurrence almost always precedes clinical recurrence [1436, 1437]. The key question
is to establish when a PSA rise is clinically significant since not all PSA increases have the same clinical value
(see Section 6.4.2) [994]. No prospective studies are available on the optimal timing for PSA testing and the
impact on oncological outcomes.

interventions.body:
WHAT I FOUND
**radiology_report**: The mpMRI prostate showed a focal lesion in the peripheral zone/transition zone at the apex/mid right, measuring approximately 12 mm. This lesion demonstrated restricted diffusion on DWI (b=1400) with corresponding early enhancement on DCE sequences. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was seen. Impression was PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral/transition zone apex/mid, with PSA density of 0.17 ng/mL/mL and csPCa predicted probability of 0.7916967.
**pathology_report**: Histological examination revealed adenocarcinoma with Gleason score 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. The tumour exhibited separate glandular tubules. No cribriform or intraductal patterns were identified. The tumour was located in the peripheral zone/transition zone, apex/mid right. The overall trajectory across timepoints showed stable low-grade disease.
**previous_notes**: Notes from July 25, 2023, indicate the patient presented with a PSA of 2.3 ng/mL, and the patient opted for a prostate biopsy.
**family_history**: No family history regarding prostate cancer was recorded.
**psa_trend**: The PSA trend shows values of 2.3 ng/mL in Jan 2023, 3.3 ng/mL in Sep 2023, 4.8 ng/mL in May 2024, and 7.0 ng/mL in Jan 2025.
**laboratory_results**: Recent laboratory results include a PSA of 7.0 ng/mL (dated 15 Dec 2024), Free PSA of 1.43 ng/mL (20%), and other routine labs (Haemoglobin, WBC, Platelets, Creatinine, eGFR, Testosterone, Alkaline phosphatase, LDH) were recorded.

WHAT IS NOT RECORDED
The detailed family history regarding prostate cancer was not recorded.
